name: Studio
intro: Studio is one workspace for generating with any model in the catalog: images, video, audio, avatars and 3D. You see the price before you generate. Here is a quick tour.

features.model-picker: Open the model picker to browse the whole catalog. Use the provider rail, category tabs, search and sort to find a model. The form below rebuilds itself to match whatever that model accepts.
features.uploading-files: Any field that takes an image, video or audio file has an upload button next to the link box. Click it, drag a file in, or paste an image, and your file is uploaded for you.
features.form-and-json-input: The Form and JSON menu next to the title switches between the labelled form and the raw request. JSON is handy when you want to copy exact settings or set a field the form does not show.
features.apps: Switch from Models to Apps for ready made apps. Each one asks only for what it needs, like a source image and a preset, and builds the request for you, with no prompt writing.
features.live-price-and-batch: The Generate button shows the price for your settings and the batch size, before you press it. The numbers above the results choose how many results each run makes.
features.my-generations: Every result is added to My generations with its prompt, model, price and time. Filter by approved or rejected, search earlier runs, and reuse a result's settings to refine it.

outro: That's Studio. Pick a model, check the price, start with one result, and compare models using the same prompt.
